summary: One PostgreSQL instance can host the gateway, controller and hub databases under different names; AAP 2.6 manages PostgreSQL 15 and supports external PostgreSQL 15, 16 and 17, with 16 and 17 needing external backup and restore.
questions: Which PostgreSQL versions does AAP 2.6 support for external databases?
Can controller, hub and gateway share one PostgreSQL instance?
Does the operator back up an external PostgreSQL 16 database?
